title: Meta's attribution is lying to you
description: Meta's attribution is lying to you
transcript: All the platforms, meta, Google, etc, etc. They have absolute atrocious attribution, meaning that it's gonna tell you that your cost per lead is $4 when in reality your cost per lead is probably $25 or $28. So you do wanna have some kind of third party tracking incorporated inside of that. And we really love Hiro's because it allows either me or our media buyers to stay inside the ads manager. So Hiro is an extension that will show you the actual number of leads, the actual number of calls and the actual number of sales and the revenue and the ROAS from that specific ad in that advertising campaign. You are, there's no way you're ever gonna get that, uh, through let's say metas, um, attribution, uh, tracking, the native attribution tracking. And so this allows me, so I don't have to have all these complex Google sheets and formulas and stuff like that. I literally just sit inside of, uh, the ads manager and I can see on an ad level which creative is producing me lowest cost per click, lowest cost per lead, lowest cost per call and thus the highest return on my ad spend.
